evidence.title: NYC sues Manhattan law firm alleging bogus injury suits

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. federal court dockets for civil RICO lawsuits filed by Uber Technologies and Federal Express Corporation
occurrences.quote_span: Companies including Uber Technologies and Federal Express Corporation have filed a string of lawsuits invoking civil RICO provisions against plaintiffs' lawyers in US federal courts.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: New York City's lawsuit against Asher & Associates and Ryan and Roberta Asher

occurrences.checkable_against: Statement by New York City Department of Transportation Commissioner Mike Flynn
occurrences.quote_span: “Fraudulent personal injury lawsuits profit on the misfortune of others and taxpayers bear the burden,” New York City Department of Transportation Commissioner Mike Flynn said in a statement.
occurrences.speaker: New York City Department of Transportation Commissioner Mike Flynn
occurrences.subject: New York City's lawsuit against Asher & Associates and Ryan and Roberta Asher

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York docket 1:26-cv-08753
occurrences.quote_span: The case is The City of New York v. Ryan H Asher, et al., US District Court for the Southern District of New York, 1:26-cv-08753
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: New York City's lawsuit against Asher & Associates and Ryan and Roberta Asher

occurrences.checkable_against: City of New York v. Ryan H Asher, et al., U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York, complaint docket 1:26-cv-08753
occurrences.quote_span: The city of New York has sued a small Manhattan law firm for allegedly bringing bogus slip-and-fall lawsuits against it in violation of federal anti-racketeering law.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: New York City's lawsuit against Asher & Associates and Ryan and Roberta Asher

occurrences.checkable_against: City of New York v. Ryan H Asher, et al., complaint and supporting case records
occurrences.quote_span: The Asher firm claimed its clients were injured riding motorcycles, scooters and bicycles on poorly-maintained city roads when they were actually injured in other ways, like a fight or a hit-and-run incident, the city said.
occurrences.speaker: New York City
occurrences.subject: New York City's lawsuit against Asher & Associates and Ryan and Roberta Asher

occurrences.checkable_against: City of New York v. Ryan H Asher, et al., complaint docket 1:26-cv-08753
occurrences.quote_span: New York is also seeking damages under the city and state False Claims Act.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: New York City's lawsuit against Asher & Associates and Ryan and Roberta Asher

occurrences.checkable_against: New York City Law Department press release concerning Asher & Associates and related court docket records
occurrences.quote_span: The Asher firm dropped its cases without explanation after the city confronted it with "contradictory statements" in the lawsuits, New York's Law Department said in a press release.
occurrences.speaker: New York City Law Department
occurrences.subject: New York City's lawsuit against Asher & Associates and Ryan and Roberta Asher

occurrences.checkable_against: Reuters communications record and responses from Ryan and Roberta Asher
occurrences.quote_span: Ryan and Roberta Asher did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: New York City's lawsuit against Asher & Associates and Ryan and Roberta Asher

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. Congress legislative records for the Racketeer Influenced and Corrupt Organizations Act
occurrences.quote_span: The case is the latest around the country to target personal injury lawyers under the federal Racketeer Influenced and Corrupt Organizations Act, a 56-year-old law passed by Congress to help rein in organized crime bosses who were often insulated by foot soldiers, for a pattern of unlawful behavior.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: New York City's lawsuit against Asher & Associates and Ryan and Roberta Asher

occurrences.checkable_against: City of New York v. Ryan H Asher, et al., U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York, complaint docket 1:26-cv-08753
occurrences.quote_span: The city, in a complaint filed Sunday in Manhattan federal court, cited 15 allegedly fraudulent lawsuits brought by Asher & Associates and its attorneys, Ryan and Roberta Asher.
occurrences.speaker: New York City
occurrences.subject: New York City's lawsuit against Asher & Associates and Ryan and Roberta Asher

occurrences.checkable_against: City of New York v. Ryan H Asher, et al., complaint docket 1:26-cv-08753
occurrences.quote_span: The city in its lawsuit said the 15 cases it cited are "the tip of the proverbial iceberg," and that it seeks to discover other lawsuits by the Asher firm that have allegedly generated "millions of dollars in legal fees, settlements and judgments based on false narratives."
occurrences.speaker: New York City
occurrences.subject: New York City's lawsuit against Asher & Associates and Ryan and Roberta Asher

occurrences.checkable_against: Statement by New York City Corporation Counsel Steven Banks
occurrences.quote_span: “Personal injury laws exist to protect actual victims of trauma, not to line the pockets of people looking to make a quick buck off City taxpayers,” New York City Corporation Counsel Steven Banks said in a statement.
occurrences.speaker: New York City Corporation Counsel Steven Banks
occurrences.subject: New York City's lawsuit against Asher & Associates and Ryan and Roberta Asher

occurrences.checkable_against: Racketeer Influenced and Corrupt Organizations Act statutory damages provisions
occurrences.quote_span: Damages are tripled under RICO if the plaintiff wins.

occurrences.subject: New York City's lawsuit against Asher & Associates and Ryan and Roberta Asher
